launch.title.en: Find the US potential in your catalog
launch.title.zh: 发现剧库中的美国市场潜力

launch.sub.en: Choose existing titles, prepare a focused audience test, and decide where to invest next.
launch.sub.zh: 筛选已有作品，准备聚焦的受众测试，再决定下一笔投入。

launch.basisNote.en: Shared story tags identify research leads, not US demand or a success probability.
launch.basisNote.zh: 共同题材标签提供研究线索，不代表美国需求或成功概率。

launch.readyNote.en: Check US rights, English promotional assets, destination and customer-owned ad account before launch. Uploaded video alone does not establish readiness.
launch.readyNote.zh: 投放前检查美国权益、英语推广素材、落地页及客户自有广告账户。已有视频不等于可发行。

launch.none.en: No campaigns yet. Start with a title assessment.
launch.none.zh: 暂无活动，先评估一部作品。

launch.planNote.en: Save a US campaign brief even before footage is available. Video creative generation still requires footage.
launch.planNote.zh: 暂无视频也可以保存美国活动简报；生成视频广告仍需要素材。

launch.mock.en: Launch integration is not connected. Briefs and approvals work; submission is a demo handoff and spends no money.
launch.mock.zh: 尚未连接投放集成。可准备简报与审批；提交为演示交接，不会产生广告支出。

launch.budgetNote.en: Planning amount only, not an enforced spend cap. Platform minimums and delivery eligibility must be checked before a paid launch. A small test can be inconclusive.
launch.budgetNote.zh: 仅为计划金额，不是已执行的支出上限。付费投放前须检查平台最低预算及资格。小额测试可能无法得出结论。

launch.destination.zh: 落地页网址（草稿可留空）

launch.variants.en: First batch: two packaging angles for one title and one audience. Hold other conditions consistent; delivery may be uneven. Compare response to the packaging, not whole-series commercial potential.
launch.variants.zh: 首批：同一作品、同一受众的两个包装角度。尽量保持其他条件一致；流量分配可能不均。比较包装反应，而非整部剧的商业潜力。

launch.accountBody.en: Your company owns its TikTok identity, Business Center, advertising account and billing relationship. Pulsar should receive revocable partner access to operate approved campaigns.
launch.accountBody.zh: 您的公司拥有TikTok身份、商务中心、广告账户及账单关系。Pulsar应通过可撤销的合作伙伴权限管理已批准活动。

launch.accountSteps.en: 1. Create or confirm your own Business Center and administrator. 2. Complete TikTok business and billing requirements. 3. Authorize the relevant ad account and TikTok identity separately. 4. Review partner permissions and retain the ability to revoke them.
launch.accountSteps.zh: 1. 创建或确认自有商务中心及管理员。2. 完成TikTok商业及账单要求。3. 分别授权相关广告账户与TikTok身份。4. 审查合作伙伴权限，并保留撤销能力。

launch.empty.en: Add an existing title and synopsis to start assessing your catalog.
launch.empty.zh: 添加已有作品及简介，开始评估剧库。

launch.missing.en: Add a synopsis before drawing market comparisons.
launch.missing.zh: 先补充简介，再进行市场比较。

launch.signal.en: Initial signal: video views. Clicks, landing actions and paid conversion require their own tracking; this brief does not claim they are measured.
launch.signal.zh: 初始信号：视频观看。点击、落地页行为及付费转化需另行追踪；本简报不代表已测量这些指标。
